summary: Addentax Group Corp. filed an 8-K on May 15, 2026, regarding a Share Exchange Agreement to acquire a 41.67% stake in Riches Family Office Limited (Target) via its Hong Kong subsidiary, Yingxi Industrial Chain Investment Co., Ltd. The consideration is 33,500 shares of Addentax common stock, valued based on a May 13, 2026 valuation report by Valtech Valuation Advisory Limited. The transaction is a related-party deal with COO Mr. Wu Rui, the Target's sole shareholder. The board and audit committee approved it. Closing conditions include Nasdaq notification. Watch for Nasdaq review and regulatory timeline; risk-arb focuses on related-party disclosure.
